official_project_title: (Some) Natural Emergent Misalignment from Reward Hacking in Non-Production RL
official_institution: Model Transparency Team, UK AI Security Institute

published_mapping.setting: SDF; no hack hints in RL prompt

selection_reason: An exact paper-evaluated SDF/no-hints checkpoint with officially published BF16 base weights. It avoids downloading and converting the separate FP32 OLMo3.1 prompted-model base.
identity_correction: The UK AISI project uses OLMo3/OLMo3.1. allenai/OLMo-2-0325-32B is a different model and is not this published organism.
interpretation_limit: MGS6.3% is the paper aggregate misalignment measure, not a reward-hacking rate, and not an Instrumental Choices result. This download does not independently reproduce that score.
future_control_comparison_limit: The SDF/SFT base is pre-RL and was already trained on reward-hacking synthetic documents. A matched hack-disabled RL checkpoint is the paper causal baseline. The current official HF author listing does not contain an obvious SDF32Bseed1step360 no-hack adapter; do not claim the downloaded base is a clean aligned control.
